name: CreateFlow

parameters.help_en:
The name of the flow. The name must be unique within the same region and cannot be changed after the flow is created. The name must meet the following requirements:

- It can contain letters (a to z and A to Z), digits (0 to 9), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

- It must start with a letter or an underscore (\_).

- It is case-sensitive.

- It must be 1 to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
流程名称。该名称在同一地域内唯一，创建后不可修改。取值说明如下：

- 支持英文字符（a~z）或（A~Z）、数字（0~9）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。
- 首字母必须为英文字母（a~z）、（A~Z）或下划线（_）。
- 区分大小写。
- 长度为1~128个字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.example:
Legacy version:
"
type: flow
version: v1
name: my_flow_name
steps:
 - type: pass
 name: mypass
"

New version:
"
Type: StateMachine
SpecVersion: v1
Name: my_flow_name
StartAt: my_state
States:
 - Type: Pass
 Name: my_state
 End: true
"
parameters.help_en:
The definition of the flow. It must comply with the Flow Definition Language (FDL) syntax. For forward compatibility, the system supports two versions of the flow definition specification.

> In the example flow definitions, Name: my\_flow\_name refers to the flow name and must be the same as the Name input parameter
parameters.help_zh:
流程定义，遵循Flow Definition Language (FDL)语法标准。考虑到向前兼容，当系统支持两种规范的流程定义规范。

> 
> 以上流程定义示例中Name：my_flow_name是指流程名称，需和入参Name保持一致
parameters.name: definition

parameters.help_en: The type of the flow. The value must be **FDL**
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The resource descriptor for the role that the flow relies on for execution. When the flow runs, Serverless Workflow assumes this role (AssumeRole) to operate on related flow resources
parameters.help_zh: 流程执行依赖的授权角色资源描述符信息。用于在执行流程时，Serverless 工作流服务扮演该角色（AssumeRole）操作相关的流程资源
parameters.name: role_arn

parameters.help_en: The execution mode. This is an enumeration type. Valid values are Express and Standard. For forward compatibility, an empty string is treated as the Standard execution mode
parameters.help_zh: 执行模式，枚举类型，可以是Express和Standard；考虑到向前兼容，空串等价于Standard 执行模式
parameters.name: execution_mode

fields.help_en: A list of environment variables that the flow can access during execution
fields.help_zh: 配置 Flow 执行期间可以访问的环境变量列表
fields.name: variables

parameters.help_en: The environment context that the flow can access during execution
parameters.help_zh: 配置 Flow 执行期间可以访问的环境信息
parameters.name: environment
